headline: Flooding lingers in Cerme, Gresik, but is easing
summary: Per 13 Januari 2026, BPBD Jawa Timur mencatat banjir masih bertahan di Kecamatan Cerme, Gresik (Desa Dungus, Pandu, dan Morowudi). Ratusan rumah, sawah, tambak, dan fasilitas umum terdampak, namun genangan cenderung menurun.
summary_id: Per 13 Januari 2026, BPBD Jawa Timur mencatat banjir masih bertahan di Kecamatan Cerme, Gresik (Desa Dungus, Pandu, dan Morowudi). Ratusan rumah, sawah, tambak, dan fasilitas umum terdampak, namun genangan cenderung menurun.
summary_en: As of 13 January 2026, BPBD East Java reported flooding still lingering in Cerme district, Gresik (Dungus, Pandu and Morowudi villages). Hundreds of homes, rice fields, fishponds and public facilities were affected, though water levels were trending down.
